headline: N-able 4EverAble2Shell zero-day and ScreenConnect attacks hit MSPs; Apache httpd HTTP/2 RCE patched; TSMC employee data leak

bullets.text: New: TSMC reportedly leaked personal data of 46,000 employees; the company says it found no evidence of a system intrusion. Also new on the board: Xen Orchestra critical flaws are being exploited (3 outlets), and an attacker targeted 60,000 GitHub repositories in a credential theft campaign.

Still the top story: an N-able zero-day dubbed "4EverAble2Shell" was exploited within hours of a public PoC; no CVE or fix is on the board. New N-central exploits also work against patched servers, giving root RCE and Windows SYSTEM access.

ConnectWise is investigating ScreenConnect breaches at nearly 50 organizations, alongside an exploited plugin flaw spreading malware across hundreds of PCs and SCKit malware abusing MSP support sessions (MSPs story: 7 outlets).

Apache HTTP Server patched a critical RCE, CVE-2026-119618, in its HTTP/2 handling (4 outlets). The SignDrop Windows zero-day turns a CLFS security feature into SYSTEM access; no CVE or fix is on the board yet.

Still developing: a critical Red Hat Quay flaw exposes all private images in a registry; the Fireworks AI hack exposed Notion chat transcripts (7 outlets); Apify is rotating API tokens after a breach; Maersk says its incident hit a legacy system.

KEV due 11-13: Barracuda CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (exploited, 4 outlets) and Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935. Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320, Outlook CVE-2026-124194 and Chromium CVE-2026-125350 are due 11-24. SITCON 3, 1.1x the 90-day average.

actions: N-able / N-central: keep consoles off the internet, watch N-able for a 4EverAble2Shell fix, and hunt for new admin accounts and unexpected agent commands.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and plugins, remove unknown clients and plugins, and hunt for SCKit or other malware pushed through support sessions.
Patch every Apache httpd instance for CVE-2026-119618 today; where you cannot, consider disabling HTTP/2 until patched.
Patch Barracuda ESG and Ivanti Connect Secure by 11-13; check Xen Orchestra deployments and restrict them to trusted networks.
Review GitHub org secrets and tokens for unexpected use; rotate Apify tokens and any secrets shared in Notion AI chats.
Windows: until a SignDrop fix ships, hunt for CLFS abuse and unexpected privilege escalation to SYSTEM.
